# Selside Quarry - benches and blocks

Shared folder for the quarry office.

- benches/  cards for each working bench
- plant/  hours notes from the workshop

turns.prompt: A planner at Selside Quarry is checking a block against its allowed stripping ratio; the ratio is the waste rock that comes off for each tonne of ore won. Block O-29 holds 15500 tonnes of ore and is planned at a ratio of 3.2 cubic metres of waste per tonne. Give the waste that block calls for, as a single number in cubic metres with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
